uint32_t dfu_check_bufcrc(uint8_t *buf, uint32_t length, uint16_t mCrcVal)

Calculate the checksum of data within a buffer in flash.

参数:

  • buf -- [in] Pointer to the buffer containing the data.

  • length -- [in] Length of the data in the buffer.

  • mCrcVal -- [out] Variable to store the calculated CRC value.

返回:

0 if checksum calculation is successful, else error line number.

uint32_t dfu_write_data_to_flash(uint16_t image_id, uint32_t offset, uint32_t total_offset, uint32_t length, void *p_void)

Write data to flash memory.

参数:

  • offset -- [in] Offset of the current image.

  • length -- [in] Length of the data to be written.
